gaps.title: Missing <main> Landmark in Root Layout
gaps.details: Root layout.tsx does not wrap page content in a <main> element. This breaks screen reader landmark navigation.

gaps.title: Missing Healthcare/Therapy Disclaimer
gaps.details: No clear disclaimer stating therapy is not medical treatment. This is a liability risk and required by insurance standards.

gaps.title: Color Contrast Below 4.5:1 for Text on Light Backgrounds
gaps.details: 2 text color combinations fail WCAG AA contrast requirements. Users with low vision cannot read affected text.

gaps.title: Form Errors Not Announced via Live Regions
gaps.details: Form validation errors appear visually but lack aria-live or role="alert". Screen readers will not announce errors immediately.

gaps.title: Links Without href Attribute
gaps.details: 21 <Link> elements found without href. These are not keyboard accessible.

gaps.title: No Contact Info for Privacy Complaints (PIPEDA Requirement)
gaps.details: Privacy policy lacks information on how to lodge complaints with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

gaps.title: Missing Terms of Service Page
gaps.details: No Terms of Service page exists. This is required to establish legal boundaries, cancellation policies, and liability limits.

gaps.title: Missing or Incomplete Viewport Meta Tag
gaps.details: Viewport meta tag missing or incomplete. Mobile users cannot zoom or resize content properly.

gaps.title: Required Fields Not Explicitly Marked (Missing aria-required)
gaps.details: Form uses HTML required attribute but not aria-required. Some screen readers may miss the requirement.

gaps.title: Generic Link Text ("Read more", "Learn more", etc.)
gaps.details: Found ~4 links with generic text. Screen readers cannot determine link purpose from text alone.

gaps.title: No Telehealth Informed Consent Disclosure
gaps.details: Booking page lacks consent statement about telehealth privacy, technical limitations, and virtual therapy risks.

gaps.title: No Business Registration or Tax Information (CRA Requirement)
gaps.details: No Business Number, HST registration, or corporate structure disclosed. Required for transparency with Canadian clients.

gaps.title: Skipped Heading Levels (e.g., H1 → H3)
gaps.details: 2 pages skip heading levels. This confuses screen reader users about content structure.

gaps.title: Interactive Elements with Small Touch Targets (< 44x44px)
gaps.details: 20 interactive elements use minimal padding. Mobile/touch users cannot reliably activate small buttons (WCAG recommends 44x44px minimum).
